title: Exercise complete baseline replacement when admitting an own task-sync rebuild
outcome: Cover the baseline membership and empty baseline branches used by exact own-rebuild adoption, or remove a branch if source analysis proves it cannot be reached.
acceptance: A behavior fixture or a source-grounded simplification accounts for a formerly admitted member missing from both the rebuild parent and retained write.
A behavior fixture or a source-grounded simplification accounts for exact own-rebuild confirmation when the new baseline has no changed rows.
